segments.dry: An overwhelming number of reviewers with dry skin, including some caused by medication, weather, or retinoid use, report significant relief from dryness and cracking, with some also noting improved fine lines.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin, including one managing MCAS and another with severe eczema, report the balm hydrates without causing irritation.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin says it provides the right amount of hydration without breaking her out.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their mid-30s to late 40s, including one describing her skin as more mature, report plumper-looking fine lines and wrinkles and improved texture.

concerns.dehydration: An overwhelming number of reviewers, including many with dry skin caused by weather, medication, or retinoid use, report deep, lasting hydration and relief from dryness or cracking by morning, several using it as an extra hydration boost mixed into other products.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some with cystic or oily acne-prone skin, report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, one calling it life-changing after 20 years of cystic acne; one reviewer, however, says it made her break out badly on her cheek.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers note reduced redness alongside their other improvements, including one whose severe eczema-related redness eased to just her usual problem areas.
concerns.barrier: One long-time user says it has helped repair her skin barrier.
concerns.aging: One reviewer in her mid-30s says her fine lines and wrinkles looked visibly plumped after a week of nightly use, with a noticeable change on her neck as well.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers say it doesn't add oiliness or greasiness, though one recommends washing it off in the morning to avoid oil buildup if left on overnight.

I have never bought high end skincare, i have severe eczema on my face and my body causing itchy, red, extremely dry peeling skin it is very painful to the point where i cant get out of bed some days. I cannot use things with fragrance. The eczema on my face does make me insecure as i am only 19 and i wanted to try out some higher end products to see if they would help. (I have literally tried everything else) I love makeup and i have not been able to where any because of how my skin is. sense drunk elephant is so popular right now and reading the ingredients i decided to give it a try. I bought the water facial, the whipped cream and the hydrating serum. I tried the waterfacial first at night, it felt hydrating and like i didnt need to put more on which is unusual for my skin because i am normally reapplying lotion or vaseline ALL THE TIME. When i woke up the skin on my face that was dry and had tightend up and was peeling i did not freak out and i got in the shower and rubbed it out off with my hands, the skin underneath was very soft and hydrated. I put on the serum and the whipped cream and again didnt feel like i need to reapply, i did use some vaseline throughout the day at work because this was just my first day using it. It is now day five of me using these products daily and the difference is insane. My skin is smooth, extremly soft, there are no dry patches or peeling a little redness only in my problem areas and my skin is hydrated. I also use another lotion throug

I'm just starting my second bottle, first one lasted me a month, I used it heavily. I was in a car accident years ago and have struggled with cystic acne for 20 years since. This is the only product I use, aside from any basic face wash. An absolute life changer and I honestly am thankful for this product every day. I had tried every oral and topical cream you can imagine in the last 2 decades. Apparently this was all I needed. Honestly makes me want to cry. ❤️

So I totally bought this on an impulse buy. I was walking the aisles looking for something for my dry weathered skin (I'm 36 and like to be outside) I tried a sample on the top of my hand and woah! Transformation. My hand that I used the sample on look instantly different from my other and ridiculous soft. I justified the price in those instant results alone. I have been using every night for a week. My fine lines and wrinkles have plumped up significantly and I keep getting complements on my "glowing skin". Also has made a significant visual change on my neck. And the hydration is just whoa! I will be keeping this In my arsenal of skin care.
Tall glass of water for your skin! I have oily acne prone skin and this is the perfect level of hydration for me. Doesn't break me out!
